collocations.en: seek legal advice from a lawyer

messages.en: Have you seen a lawyer about that house yet?
Not yet. I'm going to see him at his office tomorrow.

senses.en_definition: A building, room, or other space where people work or conduct administrative business.
(Indonesian usage) A government department or agency.
(Indonesian usage) A government official holding an important position; an officeholder.

messages.en: I'm at the office now. Do you want me to wait in the lobby?
Yes, just wait there a sec, okay? I'm coming down now.
Okay, I'll wait by the sofa next to the lift.
Has the new employee arrived at the office yet?
Yeah. He's waiting in the lobby. I'll go get him.

senses.en_definition: Work done regularly to earn a living; a job or occupation.
Work that must be done as part of a responsibility or duty; a task.
Something that is done; an act or activity.

messages.en: Have you found a permanent job yet? You said the other day you had an interview.
Not yet. I went for the interview, but they haven't got back to me. I'm just doing part-time work for now.
